title: MassMutual South Carolina Welcomes Bluewater Dental Advisors
html:
MassMutual South Carolina in Charleston expands its presence by welcoming Steven Huskey, CExP, CFP, and Brandon Wilson, RICP, to its practice.

MassMutual South Carolina in Charleston, South Carolina, has expanded its presence by welcoming the Bluewater Dental Advisors team and its founders, Steven Huskey, CExP, CFP, and Brandon Wilson, RICP, to its practice. Bluewater Dental Advisors manages more than $73 million in client assets.

“With deep industry roots and a legacy of personalized guidance built on 25 years of combined experience serving clients across the country, Wilson and Huskey have grown Bluewater Dental Advisors from a boutique advisory firm into a trusted go-to resource for dental practice owners nationwide,” said Andrew Birgel, general agent, MassMutual South Carolina. “This is an exciting chapter for MassMutual South Carolina to collaborate with such exceptional talent as we further our collective mission to help clients chart a course for stronger financial futures.”

MassMutual South Carolina is a general agency of Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company (MassMutual). The firm has served families and businesses across the Carolinas for more than 50 years with insurance, retirement, and investment solutions.

“MassMutual South Carolina is the ideal environment to deepen our roots, broaden the value we deliver to our clients and the community, and uphold the highest standard of white-glove wealth management,” said Huskey and Wilson. “MassMutual and MassMutual South Carolina are exceptional at providing the strategic guidance, resources, and expertise that allow us to scale seamlessly while serving high-net-worth business owners, families, and dental practitioners with precision and care.”

In August, MassMutual South Carolina welcomed the return of advisor Rusty Rhodes to its firm.

Securities, investment advisory, and financial planning services are offered through qualified registered representatives of MML Investors Services, LLC, Member SIPC. Supervisory office: 40 Calhoun St., Suite 310, Charleston, SC 29401. Phone: 843-856-3411. Bluewater Dental Advisors is not a subsidiary or affiliate of MML Investors Services, LLC.
